title: A Compilation of the Messages and Papers of the Presidents. Volume 8, part 2: Chester A. Arthur
summary: "A Compilation of the Messages and Papers of the Presidents. Volume 8, part 2" compiled by James D. Richardson is a historical collection published in the late nineteenth century. This volume contains the official proclamations, messages, and speeches of Chester A. Arthur and Grover Cleveland during their terms from 1881 to 1889. Part of an eleven-volume series spanning America's founding through 1902, it preserves the authentic voices of presidential leadership during a transformative period. The compilation became embroiled in controversy over copyright of public documents, sparking the Richardson Affair and shaping how government works enter the public domain.
